title: Dylan Borland: NHI involved in the cover-up

tellings.quote: goes missing. And I talked about this with Dylan, you know, uh, Borland. I was like, do you think that the nonhuman intelligence is involved in the cover up? itself or something and he was like yes I for sure know that

plain: A whistleblower named Dylan Borland is said to believe that non-human intelligence, meaning whatever beings are behind the phenomenon, is itself involved in hiding it. Michels tells this himself: he asked Borland if the non-human intelligence takes part in the cover-up, and Borland answered "yes, I for sure know that." If true, the secrecy would not come only from governments.
